## PR Checklist
- [ ] Branch was created from `dev`, not from `main` or another feature branch
- [ ] Branch name follows naming convention (feat/, fix/, db/, test/, docs/, chore/)
- [ ] PR title is imperative and specific (e.g. "Add cascade soft-delete trigger for employee → jobHistory")
- [ ] All Vitest tests pass before requesting review
- [ ] No `console.log` statements left in production code
- [ ] No `.env` files or secrets committed
- [ ] At least one team member has reviewed and approved
- [ ] Merge target is `dev` — never merge directly to `main`
- [ ] After merge, feature branch will be deleted from GitHub
